Description

In the Day view a planner can drag a job left or right to change what time it starts. It is meant to move in quarter-hour steps so a job can start at, say, quarter past eight. In practice the smallest move it will make is a whole hour, so anything that does not start on the hour cannot be set by dragging.

Branch / Environment

Branch tested: https://sv8685.qa.shopview.com/schedule · API host: https://sv8685api.qa.shopview.com · Build marker (meta app-version): v3.5-4873abe · index.html last-modified Tue, 04 Aug 2026 14:47:39 GMT, etag 9b4b1fc776ebbfb04a9a0ca051d847f7 · Organisation d55bc308-e61a-438d-b5f1-c7a73c89d49f · Location: Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 (b3c8c820-f815-4cf1-8938-10956c5ee71a, timezone America/Edmonton) · Signed in as admin@shopview.com (Administrator) · Observed 2026-08-04, 16:00-19:00 UTC.

Steps to reproduce

  1. Open the Schedule and pick the Day view for Tuesday Aug 4, 2026.
  2. Find any shift block on the grid - for example the Xiriver Apparel block, unit 16604, on Brittany Anderson's row.
  3. Note the start time in the block's hover summary.
  4. Press and hold the middle of the block and drag it a small distance to the right - about half of one hour column - then release.
  5. Read the new start time in the hover summary.

Expected behaviour

The start time moves in quarter-hour steps, so a small drag moves it 15 or 30 minutes, and a job can be set to start at 8:15 or 8:45.

Current behaviour

The start time jumps a whole hour. A drag of about half an hour's width moved the job a full hour, and no quarter-hour position can be reached by dragging.

Images

No screenshot is attached. The evidence for this ticket is a captured DOM/state reading rather than a visual difference; the exact values are in the technical section below.

Technical details for developers

A 24-pixel drag (approximately 31 minutes at the rendered zoom) issued PATCH /api/schedule/shifts/ebdd3e03-ab10-40f3-b820-4dd7e6192892 with startsAt '2026-08-04T14:00:00.000Z', i.e. exactly +60 minutes from 13:00:00Z. Spec section 4.8: 'Horizontal drag to move a shift's start time (snaps to 15-minute intervals).' Note this is a different surface from SV-8833 Open , which is about the start/end pickers inside the shift window; both stem from 15-minute granularity not being applied, but the drag path and the picker path are separate. The shift moved during this test was put back to 13:00:00Z afterwards.

Where this expected behaviour comes from: the Schedule specification, version 23, section 4.8 (Day view: timeline interactions), which says: "Horizontal drag to move a shift's start time (snaps to 15-minute intervals)."
